2026_04_ARI_NYG.headline: Arizona meets a Giants offense reshaped by Jaxson Dart’s knee injury
2026_04_ARI_NYG.paragraph1: Arizona comes out of a 36-30 loss at San Francisco needing to prevent another game from turning into a high-possession exchange, while New York enters Week 4 with its quarterback plan disrupted by Jaxson Dart’s knee injury. The Giants’ ability to protect the replacement passer and stay ahead of the sticks should determine how aggressively Arizona can pressure. For the Cardinals, sustaining drives and limiting explosive plays are the clearest ways to keep New York from controlling field position.
2026_04_ARI_NYG.model_rationale: Quarterback stability and protection are central here, with Arizona needing efficient early downs while New York adjusts its passing structure around a changed situation under center.
